{{Quote|I'm an administrator here. I can't help heal you, unfortunately.|Nillika, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:CitC" />}}
'''Nillika''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], he worked as the [[Administrator/Legends|administrator]] of the [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] [[Mos Eisley Medical Center|Medical Center]].<ref name="SWG:CitC" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> many people were caught in a firefight between [[Valarian/Legends|Lady Valarian's]] [[Valarian Syndicate|guards]] and [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt's]] [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|thugs]] in Mos Eisley. The [[2-1B surgical droid/Legends|2-1B droid]] [[2-1b-58|Billingsly]] sent a spacer to Mos Eisley to help the local medical staff. The droid also sent the medic's profile and payment to Nillika. After the medic had treated the injuries of [[Escara Frei]] and [[Jorund Redd]], Nillika handed out 5000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and a [[field surgeon ring]] to the medic.<ref name="SWG:CitC" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateScientistHumanMale.png|thumb|right|250px|Every randomly-generated depiction of Administrator Nillika.]]
Administrator Nillika was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:CitC" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Administrator Nillika was added to the game upon the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]", a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>

Because Administrator Nillika spawned under the generic "medic_11_admin" template, his appearance was randomized under one of two possible depictions. He appeared consistently a Human male, however.<ref name="SWG:CitC" />

Administrator Nillika was part of the low-level quest "[[W:c:swg:Caught in the Crossfire|Caught in the Crossfire]]" for players of the [[W:c:swg:Medic|Medic profession]]. After the player has treated Escara Frei and Jorund Redd, Billingsly sents the player to Nillika to receive the rewards. In this message, the NPC was erroneously called "Nillka".<ref name="SWG:CitC" />
